slides.texte_overlay:
1. Your body keeps the receipts

Every skipped workout,
every late night. It all adds up.

2. Friendships take effort

No one calls by accident anymore.
You have to make the plan.

3. Quiet beats loud

The men you respect most
rarely talk about themselves.

4. You can't outwork
bad rest

Tired men make bad calls.

5. Your parents
are just people

They were guessing too.
Forgive them earlier.

6. Your mind needs
training too

The gym for your body,
something daily for your head.

training too

Use a micro-learning app like
